cd /workspace && find project -type f -printf '%s %p\n' | sort -nr && ls -ld tmp && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,json,time,random,itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
from driver import solve,LIMITS
R=[{'name':chr(65+i),'label':i+1} for i in range(16)]
# 32768 literal rules with maximum total path occurrences, many common suffixes.
pol=''.join('match('+a+','+b+') allow;' for a,b in itertools.islice(itertools.cycle(itertools.product('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP',repeat=2)),32768))
def run(text):
 req=json.dumps({'jobs':[{'services':R,'limits':LIMITS,'events':[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':text},{'op':'inspect'}]}]}).encode()
 t=time.process_time();out=solve(req);print('cpu',time.process_time()-t,'bytes',len(req),'result',str(out)[:100])
run(pol)
# Largest permitted aggregate path length with long distinct literals.
rng=random.Random(201)
pol=''.join('match('+','.join(rng.choices('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP',k=16))+') allow;' for _ in range(4096))
run(pol)
# Many inspections, maximal 16 resident versions, u32 epochs.
ev=[{'op':'stage','epoch':4294967270+i,'policy':'startswith() allow;'} for i in range(16)]
ev+= [{'op':'inspect'}]*199984
req=json.dumps({'jobs':[{'services':R,'limits':LIMITS,'events':ev}]}).encode()
t=time.process_time();res=solve(req);dur=time.process_time()-t
t=time.process_time();out=json.dumps(res,separators=(',',':'));print('bulk replay',dur,'encoding',time.process_time()-t,'bytes',len(out))
